description: Search Kidincare for licensed childcare centers, daycares and preschools in the United States. Filter by keyword, city, state or ZIP code. Returns name, address, phone, ages served and the Kidincare page for each center. Use get_center with a returned id for full details.

query.description: Center name or program type, e.g. "montessori" or "head start".

state.description: US state name or two-letter code, e.g. "Pennsylvania" or "PA".

name: search_centers
title: Search Centers Tool
